# case: missing file
cd tmp1
! exec ssg build --source test
cmp stdout ../invalid_layout_missing_file.txt


# case: missing directory
cd ../tmp2
! exec ssg build --source test
cmp stdout ../invalid_layout_missing_directory.txt


# case: pathname conflict
cd ../tmp3
! exec ssg build --source test
cmp stdout ../invalid_layout_filename_conflict.txt

build failed: file 'test\themes\default\post.css' does not exist
-- invalid_layout_missing_directory.txt --
build failed: directory 'test\posts' does not exist
-- invalid_layout_filename_conflict.txt --
